messages:
owen: Heads-up - vendor NimbusCloud is stuck in our marketplace onboarding. Two blockers: (1) marketplace is rejecting their invoices due to missing tax_jurisdiction and nonstandard PO number format, (2) legal pushed back on a broad IP clause in the CLA. Can deal desk help coordinate?
rita: Which PO format is required? I thought we accept numeric and alphanumeric.
jon: Our AP system enforces PO regex: ^PO-[0-9]{6}$ (six digits). Nimbus is sending `NMB-2026-77`. That fails auto-join in ERP -> invoice processing stalls.
owen: Got it. I've asked Nimbus to send a sample invoice. marketplace-bot returned schema error earlier: invoice_schema.invalid_field -> "seller.tax_jurisdiction missing"
marketplace-bot: Validation error 422: invoice_schema.missing_field -> "seller.tax_jurisdiction"
sarah: Legal note: CLA has a carveout that assigns improvements to the vendor. They want perpetual rights backfilled. We can't accept that. Suggest swapping to a mutual improvements clause and limit to integration code only.
jon: Procurement also needs vendor tax ID and remittance instructions in their vendor profile before we approve the PO flow. Nimbus provided tax id but not tax_jurisdiction per invoice.
rita: Quick win: we can accept their vendor profile if they update invoice line_items to include `billing_code` and `tax_jurisdiction`. I'll send them the exact JSON payload sample.
owen: Please include the required PO format too. Sample we expect:
```
{
  "po_number": "PO-123456",
  "invoice_number": "INV-2026-948",
  "seller": {"name": "NimbusCloud", "tax_id": "98-7654321", "tax_jurisdiction": "US-CA"},
  "line_items": [{"sku": "RWD-DED-1", "billing_code": "RD-DED", "amount": 2400}]
}
```
sarah: On CLA: if vendor won't change the IP assignment, we can offer a compromise: limited license to pre-existing vendor improvements for the duration of the partnership and automatic reversion on termination. That should be acceptable to Nimbus legal in many cases.
jon: Timeline: Nimbus wants to be in the marketplace by Monday. Not realistic unless they send corrected invoice samples today and legal narrows the CLA ASAP.
rita: I'll request invoice template + sample invoices and the updated PO format today. Also opening a vendor onboarding ticket.
marketplace-bot: Ticket #MKP-8502 opened for Nimbus onboarding errors. Assigned to marketplace-integrations.
owen: AE will push SOW and confirm whether the integration appendix is signed; if SOW appendix E arrives we can start soft enablement.
sarah: I'll draft the compromise language and share with vendor counsel. If they accept, legal can sign within 24-48 hours.
jon: Noted. I'm blocking final approval on invoice automation. If we get a sample with PO matching ^PO-[0-9]{6}$ and tax_jurisdiction populated, I'll flip the switch in the ERP workflow.
owen: Great. I'll track in deal desk board and escalate to partnerships lead if vendor misses EOD. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm your task.
rita: Pinged vendor procurement. They acknowledged and said they will resend templates within 3 hours.
sarah: Shared CLA compromise. Waiting on vendor comments.
jon: Received one corrected invoice sample (looks good) but still need the billing_code at line level. Vendor says their billing system can't surface it but will add a metadata field. I'll test once they push.
owen: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in stand if anything breaks. If legal or finance escalate I'll loop in leadership. :pray:
